transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?
Hello Dr. Smith, my name is Garrett. My thoughts feel like they’re racing nonstop, jumping from idea to idea so fast that I can’t keep my head clear, even in sessions.
Have you also been feeling more energetic, unusually confident, or in a notably high or irritable mood lately?

Yes, absolutely. I've been swinging between feeling almost euphoric and invincible—like I'm on the verge of a major breakthrough—and getting irrationally snappy with my wife and colleagues over tiny things. At the same time, I feel this relentless, high-energy drive to constantly keep producing and doing things without stopping.
How long have these mood swings and high-energy periods been going on, and have they lasted for several days or more at a time?

This has been going on for much longer than just a few days. The entire episode, starting with that intense, high-energy "buzz" after my conference, has actually been unfolding over the past few months. It's been incredibly jarring to look back and realize how long this cycle has been dominating my life.

Have there been periods during this time when your mood was noticeably low, with loss of interest in activities, poor concentration, or feelings of worthlessness lasting for most of the day, nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, for about the last four months, I've been stuck in a heavy, low state where things I normally love like painting, hiking, and clinic work feel completely flat and optional. I'm carrying this crushing sense of guilt and worthlessness, feeling like I've completely failed my patients and colleagues. On top of that, I have this bone-deep fatigue that makes even the simplest daily tasks feel incredibly heavy.
Have you had clear periods of time between these episodes where you felt completely back to your usual self, with stable mood and energy levels?

Before this started a few months ago after my conference, I felt completely like my usual, balanced self and in control of my life. This is actually the very first time I've ever experienced anything like this, so I don't have a history of previous episodes to compare it to.
